task_summary: Develop an ML interatomic potential analysis for energies, forces, and interpretable latent charges with emphasis on long-range electrostatics using provided benchmark datasets.

datasets.name: random_charges
datasets.target_use: recover exact atomic charges from energies and forces; Fig. 1-style benchmark

datasets.name: charged_dimer
datasets.target_use: evaluate binding energy curves beyond short-range cutoff; Fig. 3-style benchmark

datasets.name: ag3_chargestates
datasets.target_use: distinguish charge-state-dependent PES for Ag3; Fig. 5e and Table 1-style benchmark

methodological_commitments: use provided datasets as task-specific benchmarks
produce interpretable latent-charge-related analysis rather than only generic regression metrics
benchmark long-range electrostatics behavior against short-range limitations where possible
